description: This file defines an internal interface IMemberDescription and a sealed class MemberDescriptionTypeComparer within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. The interface specifies properties and methods related to member descriptions, likely used for code generation or reflection purposes. The class provides equality comparison logic for IMemberDescription instances.

classes.name: IMemberDescription
classes.description: An internal interface representing a description of a member, including properties for field ID, symbol, type, containing type, assembly name, type name, type syntax, and flags for constructor parameter, serializability, and copyability.

classes.name: MemberDescriptionTypeComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IEqualityComparer<IMemberDescription> to compare member descriptions based on their type name and assembly name.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Returns a TypeSyntax object for a given ITypeSymbol.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines whether two IMemberDescription instances are equal based on their type name and assembly name.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an IMemberDescription instance based on its type name and assembly name.
